Value.Value: This subflow helps to toggle switch using Field Label and Toggle input as Yes or NO
Using Swtch case to compare the input of Toggle(Yes/No).

If Toggle is Yes and aria-checked is True, No action will be performed since toggle switch is already in On state. If Toggle is Yes and aria-checked is False, Click Toggle action is done to toggle the swicth to On state.

Retrieving aria-checked attribute value to validate if the toggle switch is On or Off. aria-checked attribute returns either True or False. True corresponds to Toggle switch is On. False corresponds to Toggle switch is Off.

If Toggle is No and aria-checked is False, No action will be performed since toggle switch is already in Off state. If Toggle is No and aria-checked is True, Click Toggle action is done to toggle the swicth to Off state.
